The source notes explicitly state that visible instances are collected into a dictionary `chunksToRender` keyed by chunk position. It further describes iterating over this dictionary and passing the instance arrays (`blocks`) to the shader for rendering (`shader.RenderChunk(chunkPos, blocks)`). In the context of graphics programming, passing data to a shader for rendering constitutes passing it to the GPU. Therefore, every fact in the claim is supported by the evidence.
